name: priority-icon
title: Priority icon
description: Five priority levels in one 16 or 14 px glyph, so a dense row says how urgent an issue is without a word: three dashes for none, one to three bars from Low to High, and a red disc with an exclamation mark for Urgent, the only level in color. A new level grows the bars one after another and pops the disc in, and every glyph carries its own name for screen readers and a hover title.
